author: Allalilacias
body:
The mirror is a mistake. Even without seeing the stats of your other staffs or anything else, it decreases your ward, with which you could get some protection, and returns only mana, which, as a mage, you already have plenty of.

Double wielding will most likely be your best option for optimal damage, unless the difference between your staffs is too big. But, at your tier, that's difficult, since most staffs have similar magic. Try them on and check your stats on the status screen. Choose the most optimal choice. It will definitely not be what you have on screen.

The quality of your gear seems a bit suboptimal, as well. The best is famed, outside of your weapon, and that's not good. Even if they're boss gear, at that quality, there's bound to be better gear available. This tells me that you're either really unlucky, don't do dungeon or world killing too much or you've just chosen your gear improperly. As before, check the quality of it and the stats on the bot and choose the best one.

If they're your best pieces of gear, upgrade them as high as possible. I know it seems counterintuitive because you'll be dropping them soon, but it works wonders, take it as an investment.

If, after all this, you're still struggling, without more information on your character or a good screenshot of your gear, I don't think we can help you much more. Be sure to drop by orna discord, they should be able to help you there a bit better since most of the most experienced and dedicated teachers are there (they'll also answer faster).

author: infam0usx
body:
Buy Adept and Druid classes (if you don't have them already) and buff up at the start of the dungeon. At this tier I have found out that starting with Golem's Fortitude and Barrier II is a must. Farm some kingdom T5 mimic raid for ring of day or arch-gadget and you will be able to also use Jhin's Talent without losing defense.
Ideal loadout for your tier has those 4 spells and uses them at the start of gauntlet: Golem's Fortitude, Barrier II, Magic Boost, Jhin's Talent (use Jhin's Talent only if you have either ring of day or arch-gadget). After this you should be good to go.

author: geoffnolan
body: Magic Strikes uses your attack stat to create magic damage- not the goal if you want to do magic damage with your magic stat. Use your strongest elemental spells for now, later on you will get Sorrow and Drain for some non-elemental magic damage. Also, I second using a 2nd staff. Pick up Druid if you haven’t, use buffs at the beginning of the dungeon (the buffs persist the whole dungeon)
